name: flight_search_kyiv_warsaw
description: Customer-facing route search over the denormalized flight read model.
sql: SELECT flight_status, COUNT(*) AS flights, SUM(seats_available) AS seats FROM flights WHERE from_city = 'Kyiv' AND to_city = 'Warsaw' GROUP BY flight_status ORDER BY flight_status;

name: route_dashboard_top_routes
description: Read-heavy dashboard over pre-aggregated route facts.
sql: SELECT from_city, to_city, SUM(search_count) AS searches, SUM(booking_count) AS bookings, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM route_daily_stats GROUP BY from_city, to_city ORDER BY searches DESC, revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

name: route_origin_demand
description: Route demand summary over pre-aggregated route facts.
sql: SELECT from_city, SUM(search_count) AS searches FROM route_daily_stats GROUP BY from_city ORDER BY searches DESC LIMIT 20;

name: booking_status_distribution
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS bookings, SUM(total_price) AS gross FROM bookings GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

name: user_role_distribution
description: User role distribution over the account table.
sql: SELECT role, COUNT(*) AS users FROM users GROUP BY role ORDER BY role;
